notes.s: That is, they engaged in single combat; the spot for such encounters being called a holm, consisting of a circular space marked out by stones.

Thorpe's edition has one more stanza at the end (his 83), which Guðni Jónsson's text does not print: Wondrous lore / has in dream to thee been sung, / but thou hast seen the truth: / no man has been / so wise created / that has before heard the Sun-Song.
